description: Section 96a application for Non-Material Amendment to planning permission ref. 38787/APP/2025/3215 dated 13-04-2026 (Variation of Condition 2 (Approved Drawings) of planning permission ref. 38787/APP/2024/2435, dated 15-11-2024 (Variation of Condition 2 (approved drawings) of planning permission ref. 38787/APP/2022/254 dated 21-04-2022 (Demolition of the existing building and the erection of a 2 storey, 7 bedroom detached dwellinghouse, including the excavation of a basement to provide habitable space and a sunken squash court with associated works) for the construction of a garden building.) to amend the fenestration.
decision_conditions: Condition 1 (Approved Plans) attached to planning permission reference 38787/APP/2025/3215, dated 13-04-26, is amended to the following:
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted drawing numbers:
101 Rev A - Proposed Site Plan with Garden Building
111 Rev A - Proposed Floor Plans First, Second & Roof Plans
5740 /A104 Rev J - Existing and Proposed Street Elevation
Tree Survey and Arboricultural Impact Assessment ref. GHA/DS/222160:24 dated 05-08-2024 prepared by GHA Trees
Tree Protection Plan Rev D dated August 2024
and shall thereafter be retained/maintained for as long as the development remains in existence.

Notwithstanding the non-material amendments hereby approved, all other conditions relating to planning permission reference 38787/APP/2025/3215, dated 13-04-26, must be discharged/adhered to as per that permission.
